Build an event table

Source: R/events.R
pmx_ode_events.Rd

Doses and observation times as NONMEM-style records: one dose record per element of amt (recycled with dose_time, cmt, rate, dur, ii, addl and ss), and one observation record per element of time.

Usage

pmx_ode_events(
  amt = double(),
  cmt = 1L,
  time = double(),
  dose_time = 0,
  ii = 0,
  addl = 0L,
  rate = 0,
  dur = 0,
  ss = 0L,
  id = 1L
)

Arguments

amt

Dose amounts.

cmt

The compartment each dose goes into, by name or number.

time

Observation times.

dose_time

When each dose is given.

ii, addl

Interval and number of additional doses after each one.

rate, dur

Infusion rate or duration; 0 for a bolus. rate = -1 takes the rate from the model's rate(), rate = -2 the duration from its dur().

ss

Steady state: 1 resets and doses to steady state, 2 adds the steady state to what is there.

id

The subject.

Value

A data frame of class pmx_ode_events with columns ID, TIME, EVID, AMT, CMT, RATE, DUR, II, ADDL and SS, sorted by time with doses before observations at the same time.

Examples

pmx_ode_events(amt = 100, ii = 24, addl = 6, cmt = "depot",
               time = seq(0, 168, by = 24))
#>   ID TIME EVID AMT   CMT RATE DUR II ADDL SS
#> 1  1    0    1 100 depot    0   0 24    6  0
#> 2  1    0    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 3  1   24    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 4  1   48    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 5  1   72    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 6  1   96    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 7  1  120    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 8  1  144    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
#> 9  1  168    0   0 depot    0   0  0    0  0
